mandate.body:
## Cross-chat economic mandate — 2026-10-20 (persistent decision, not profitability evidence)

This decision is binding for future autonomous and fresh-chat sessions. Prior runs repeatedly reverted to low-value engineering despite the owner's explicit demand for dollar-positive PAPER results. A new chat, an abbreviated summary, a PR, a CI success, or a new run must **not** reset this priority.

**Single success criterion:** Independently authenticated, prospective, capital-matched, >=72h complete first-observed original source and **positive ABSOLUTE whole-account marked PAPER equity after fees, funding, spreads, slippage, missed fills, open positions and margin effects**, with robust chronological performance. Until proved: **NO VERIFIED EDGE / NOT PROFITABLE**, and LIVE DISABLED.

**Working rule before any PR:** Quote latest authenticated absolute whole-account after-cost PnL and source-validity verdict; choose ONE falsifiable gross-alpha hypothesis tied to specific dollar impact; name available authentic evidence, predeclared candidate/control, execution fills/no-fills and stop/reject rule. If this cannot be done, no strategy PR is justified. Do not count CI, diagnostics, recovery, PR totals, relative PnL improvement or profitable retrospective subsets as economic progress.

**Hard anti-loop gate:** No standalone observability, CI, worker or infrastructure work except a narrowly demonstrated source-critical defect that directly blocks the selected economic experiment. Never fabricate/cleanse source, retime original clocks, reset v2/v5 losses, duplicate or forcibly restart traders, weaken safety, or place LIVE orders. A safely healthy PAPER worker must not be disrupted to install a patch. Do not promote strategies on missing data or selective samples. If the current strategy's forward robust gross edge cannot be established, reject/shelve it and test a genuinely different alpha thesis.

**Cross-chat boot requirement:** Re-read this decision, Issue #469 (authenticated worker/ledger/source), Issue #1258 (audit), current main/open PRs and active workflow run/JOB/SHA, and current scheduled economic mandate BEFORE deciding what to build. Treat older snapshots as historical only. Persist each **new substantive economic verdict** here; avoid repetitive progress comments. Report dollars and evidence, not GitHub activity.

This comment is a mandate and process correction, NOT a result, certification, code change, verified new quote, or claim of profitability.
